<pre class="pseudocode" data-line-number="true">
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{BTreeInsert}{$T,k$}
\If{$T.root$ is full}
\State 새 root $s$ 생성; $s.child[0]\gets T.root$
\State \Call{SplitChild}{$s,0$}; $T.root\gets s$
\EndIf
\State \Call{InsertNonFull}{$T.root,k$}
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
</pre>
